We take a little break, and make up later.

What are your thoughts on wreckin' stuff?

Been there, pal!
Hope you've got a friend who can help you fix things like I do.

Sunbirds.
Something else...

Ravens.

Rock!
Paper!
Scissors!
ROCK!

ROCK!

Wanna play again?

I've gotta run.

Rock!
Paper!
Scissors!
Dynamite!
Paper!

Paper!

Paper!

Sorry, that was a trick.

Have you seen Vanellope? I bet she doesn't know about dynamite yet!
No problem. Don't work too hard, okay?

Ooh, I should get back to looking for her. Where IS she...?
Aw thanks, {PlayerName}. Right back at ya!

I don't know, but I'm a little freaked out!

That voice is SO familiar...

... Just a guess.

Wanna join us? I've got a pretty big surprise planned for our Valley villains.

Well, Bad-Anon meetings really help me and my fellow video game Bad Guys understand that we're not bad guys.
I thought folks here might need to remember that, so I invited Scar and Mother Gothel over.
Ralph, you're so sweet.

Could ya talk to Ursula about that soup she had ya make?
Hey, meet me in my House, okay? I gotta talk to you about the challenge.
Did you find any clues, {PlayerName}?
Mother Gothel hid the statue in the Dark Castle Plaza. I'm heading there now.
I'm going to clear away all the thorns and mess around the Do-Gooder Trophy in the Dark Plaza.
I've got to return from the Dark Plaza with the Do-Gooder Trophy.
You did it! The trophy is back! Thanks, {PlayerName}.
Could you talk to Scar? Sounds like he was pretty motivated to help the community if it means winning the trophy.
Hey, I'm gonna tell Ursula about our contest. But, uh, I think we should talk to her together.

Meet me in my House. The Bad-Anon meeting's about to start.
Whoa! You brought back the trophy! You gotta put it some place where everybody can see it!

We gotta talk and get the Bad-Anon meeting started.
I need to gather the flowers I grew on the Sunlit Plateau!
{PlayerName}, I... I can't believe it.

Bad-Anon was a good idea, but even good ideas don't work all the time.
Some folks don't want to change.
I'm used to doing most of the work around here, TBH.
But who would choose to be bad? Like bad for real?
If you ask them, Ursula, Scar, and Mother Gothel will say they've done nothing wrong.
Villains are gonna villain, Ralph.
I... Gee, I guess so. You know what?
{PlayerName}, you're the best do-gooder in the Valley. You win the Do-Gooder Trophy!
Put it wherever you want. Maybe it'll inspire other good Villagers to do more good stuff.
So inspiring!
Maybe...
Don't hold your breath.
Thanks. Still, I think I'm gonna close the Valley chapter of Bad-Anon.
Villains are gonna be villains, right? I've just gotta do my own thing.
Thanks for reminding me of that, {PlayerName}. Lesson learned!
Don't worry.
I'm done with Bad-Anon in the Valley.
Well, that just proves what I was already thinkin'...
{PlayerName}, this is bad! This is REALLY bad!
Not even the GOOD kind of bad, either. The Do-Gooder Trophy's gone!
Let's search for clues.
Don't worry, Ralph; we'll find it!
If it was taken, we can find the culprit.
Trophies don't vanish into thin air.
I sure hope you're right, {PlayerName}. My Bad-Anon pals are not gonna like it if they find out there's no trophy.
Taken? But this is the Valley! Folks don't steal here... Do they?
Great! We're all here. Welcome to your first Bad-Anon meeting. Okay, first thing we do is say the motto. Here, I'll lead...
"I'm bad, and that's good—"
Pardon me, I must have received someone else's invitation. I've never done a single thing "badly" in my life.
I've absolutely no idea why I'm here either. Certainly the Sea Witch is a more appropriate guest.
I would've thought her ridiculous human form would let her stride right on in, as she always does.
Wh— Okay. Good point. I'll talk to Ursula after the meeting. Now, can we get back on track?
Listen to Ralph...
He wants to help you.
Give him a chance to talk.
It's going to be hilarious.
{PlayerName}'s right!
Um, let's skip the motto for today. What would you say is your number one problem in the Valley?
That's easy. No one acknowledges my intellectual superiority and rightful place as king.
What ISN'T a problem?! Everyone blames me for the most ridiculous things.
Scar, all you do is sulk and scheme.
Take the hint, Mother Gothel.
I'm with these two. It's a Valley of Goody Two-shoes.
And why shouldn't I? I get the lion's share of the suffering.

I love desserts!

I'll get Vanellope, and then we can start!
I'll give you a hint: It's one prize, but it's always WAY more than one.
Okay, but don't wait too long! This prize is gonna blow your socks off!
Hey, {PlayerName}, put those cakes on the table in my House, would ya?

Vanellope seems weirdly confused about this game. I'm gonna go talk to her.
Did you get everything you need to make our ads for the scavenger hunt?
Did you make those ads for the scavenger hunt?

Get to Skull Rock and start the scavenger hunt!
Did you find the scavenger hunt treasures inside Skull Rock?

Could ya go talk to Tiana? She's got the cakes for our first mini-game!

Vanellope doesn't seem happy about this contest. I think we better talk about it.

Ralph, that was EPIC!
Talk about exciting!
Aw, I thought I'd win for sure.
Hey, thanks for playing, everyone! And now, it's my greatest pleasure to award the Prize of ALL PRIZES to my very best friend — VANELLOPE!
I thought I won?
Like, we're sharing the prize?
This is my villain origin story!
What are you talking about, Ralph? I didn't win. I spent half the game trying to stand on Sulley's shoulders for a better vantage point.
Well, so long, chums! I'm gonna convince Sulley to help me look for more treasure here. He is freakishly tall!
What? Oh. Okay. Bye, Vanellope...
But you love winning! Don't you want the prize?
I love YOU, you big galoot. But fair's fair: The prize goes to {PlayerName}!
Vanellope's right. Sorry, {PlayerName}. I... I just wanted to make her happy. Anyway, your prize is — pause for effect — a <ActivityItem>Deluxe Prize Counter</ActivityItem>!
Hope you enjoy it.
You DON'T love it. I can tell! Aw, snapdragons.
Ralph, you big gummy bear, we eat desserts EVERY DAY. And I love it — really!
It's just... well, we ate two cakes yesterday, and the day before that, and—
But now we have to do it <Lore>really</Lore> fast! And {PlayerName} is here! Doesn't that make it hardcore?
It's a cute idea, Ralph!
Maybe we can find a new mini-game?
Sounds like you do this a lot?
Cute is NOT hardcore! I want it to be cool for Vanellope!
YA— Wait, what?
Aw, c'mon! I was only joking. We can eat cake, buddy!

...MIND-BLOWING...

FISHING!!!

What if we have a <Lore>scavenger hunt</Lore> inside Skull Rock?!

I'm gonna win the big mystery prize!

{PlayerName}, what if you made ads but out of paper or glass or somethin'? Here, take this to help you build the ads, and I'll head to Skull Rock and get everything else set up!
It sounds great! How do we get the word out?
HA! Not if I win it first!
Not a chance, flyboy!
Hey Ralph, how do we get the word out so I have some real competition?

Ready...
Set...
GO! GO! GO!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_030_VL.en: Whoa! Just lookin' at this plate is makin' my eyes burn!
I'll bring it to Vanellope and Sulley.
Meet me in the <Lore>Dreamscape</Lore>!
Hey, {PlayerName}! Got a minute?
I need some help cookin' food for a picnic with Sulley and Vanellope.

Does Sulley like spicy food? What's going on?
Let's talk later, Ralph.
Sure he does! I mean, probably, right?
And if he DOESN'T, it'll be a super hilarious prank! Everybody loves those.
Let's get cooking, I guess?
Are you up to something, Ralph?
Let's prank Sulley AND Vanellope!
Great!
Could you take this <Lore>SUPER Spicy Chili Pepper</Lore> for the recipe? It's infused with the power of 10,000 chili peppers!
While you do that, I'm gonna make the SOUREST lemonade possible. That's not part of the prank — Vanellope LOVES sour stuff!

Why?
Go on...
Whatever, let's cook!
Well, then me and Vanellope can hang out ALL THE TIME instead of PRETTY MUCH all the time, just like before Sulley...
Are you jealous Vanellope has a new friend?
It's okay to make new friends.
I get it. I love being petty. Let's cook!
What? NO! Vanellope has lots of friends here. This is totally a not-personal prank.
ANYWAY...!

Did you cook up that really spicy meal yet?
Could you bring me that spicy food you cooked?
Meet me in the Dreamscape. Vanellope and Sulley are there.

We need to go to the Dark Castle? How come?
Could ya help me puzzle this out, {PlayerName}?
Did you get all that stuff for Vanellope's apology surprise?
Have you put together that surprise for Vanellope? Trust me, you're gonna love it!
I'm going to take a selfie to remember this moment!
Ralph, I think you're dealing with some dark feelings. I need to talk to someone who knows all about that.
Guess we need to have a talk in the Dark Castle with {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten}, huh?
Let's go talk to Vanellope. I can't wait to hear how much she liked our prank.
You finished Vanellope's surprise. Nice! Would ya mind putting it somewhere so we can surprise her?
Let's meet in Dreamlight Valley!
I can't believe you made this!

I'm just glad things are back to normal.
It's powered by friendship!
Ralph versus Sulley dance-off?
Better than normal. "Normal with a dance machine AND new friends."
Aw, Ralph, buddy, you know you're my bestest best friend forever, right?

Ralph!
It's okay, Vanellope. It was a pretty good joke, honestly.
No one asked you, fuzzball.
Ralph, I think you should apologize.
Sorry Sulley, sorry Vanellope. I helped.
Everyone relax! It was just a joke!
Why? I didn't steal my own best friend and have a picnic without me—
You were INVITED!
Ralph, you're being a BIG JEALOUS BABY right now!
Sulley is great! I know you'll like him. You just need to give him a chance.
And until you do, I'm not gonna hang out with you.
What?! *sigh* This is not how I thought this day was gonna go.
I appreciate the apology, {PlayerName}.
I aPpReCiAtE— C'mon! Stop handling everything so maturely!
Jokes are FUNNY. This was just mean.
Mean is having a picnic without me!
Heard Ralph and Vanellope got in a big fight. True or false?
Ralph is jealous.
It was a serious best-friend brawl.
I feel bad for Sulley. He's stuck in the middle.
You know, until you invited me to stay here, I was jealous too.
Maybe I can talk to him. I owe him one for the whole banishing you from the Valley thing.
Meet me in the <Lore>Dark Castle</Lore>, okay? I'll get Ralph.
Sounds like Ralph is dealing with some dark feelings.
Sulley's... What do you call it? Well-adjusted? He'll be okay. Ralph, though...
This place is, um... dark. Kinda reminds me of a haunted house simulator.
Ralph, {PlayerName}, do you know what the Dark Castle is made out of?
Uh... Bricks?
Anger and angst?
I don't know, but I LOVE your decor.
I'm guessing it's NOT bricks?
Exactly.
Everything here was built out of my deepest, darkest feelings: anger, loneliness, jealousy. It might look like a castle, but it's really a prison.
If we let our dark feelings have control, they will take over. They'll overwhelm and trap us.
Ralph, don't let jealousy and anger win.
{character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten} is right.
Do you understand, Ralph?
Great speech. Wow.
I know. And I don't wanna be jealous. Sometimes, I just can't help it! Guess I could use some help figuring it out. Feels like my insides are all in pieces.
Whoa!
Kinda. I don't wanna be jealous. Sometimes, I just can't help it! Guess I could use some help figuring it out. Feels like my insides are all in pieces.
How does this help? I don't wanna be jealous. Sometimes, I just can't help it! What do I do with all these feelings?
Heh, thank you.
Really? Could've fooled me.
Not brick, not stone...
Sulley! Could we, uh... Could we talk? About before — I guess I felt like you were trying to be Vanellope's best friend.
But {PlayerName} and {character:DreamlightValley!TheForgotten} helped me realize I can't let these big feelings trap me.
There was a glowing orb and a puzzle thingy? Look, I don't know! I just wanna say... I'm sorry.
Hey, I get it. My best friend might've reacted the same way. Apology accepted, buddy.
Nice apology, Ralph.
So we're all friends now?
I was hoping for more drama.
It's sincere. I mean it.
Sulley... friends?
Of course! But, how are we gonna make this up to Vanellope?
She can be one stubborn kid.
Maybe we could all make something together?
Invent a special dance and show it to her!
Bribe her with Star Coins and desserts!
That's a great idea!
I know what to make! {PlayerName}, can I give you the plans and something special to use in it?

Happy to help.

You'll see...
Sulley, my new friend, what has Vanellope told you about our arcade...?
Excellent! Now...
There will be dancing! You'll see! Now...
Dancing? Uh...
That could work. Maybe it should be something fun, though. Something we can do together.
I hope so. What do you say, Sulley... friends?
Well, it might not be over yet. I still gotta apologize to Vanellope.
I get it now. Jealousy isn't helping me be Vanellope's friend. It's pushing her away AND stopping me from making new friends. {PlayerName}, we gotta go back to the Valley. I need to talk to Sulley!

WreckItRalph_Ralph/Ralph_VLG_Ralp_040_VL.en: Ah! I mean, HI! Hi there, {PlayerName}.
Glad I ran into you, actually. I... Uh... Well, I may have broken the Valley. A little!
And you might be the only one who can help me fix it.
You BROKE THE VALLEY?
I'm sure it's fine. Let's talk later.
Hear me out... Sulley and I have been hangin' out a lot, and get this: He's never really played VIDEO GAMES!
I know he made some sorta game to teach Vanellope about electricity.
So, I wanted to make one for him and... well, you better <Lore>come to my House and see what happened</Lore>.
Who doesn't play video games?!
Huh? Really? Okay... See you later?
You'd better come to my House, {PlayerName}.
See, there are cherries everywhere now! Could ya help me catch 'em?
Could you pick up that Memory? We need to see what's inside.

Almost there! I just need to apply the new enchantment to my Pickaxe.
I'm going to fix up all the glitching furniture inside the second House in the Memory.
I found another Memory in Tiana's House. I should open it and see what's inside...

In a weird way, you really did make a fun game!
That code book needs to go back to the Dreamlight Library IMMEDIATELY.
And boy am I glad of it!
You know something? You've got a way of makin' scary things WAY less scary. Like thinking you lost your best friend to a big blue furry monster or breaking the Valley.
You're a real pal, pal.
Here, take this. It's just a little something to remind you of our friendship.
And, hey! Take the <ActivityItem>Giant Cherries</ActivityItem> too.
Just come and find me if they do anything weird. Like, they get messed up so they're half stuck in a wall, or they make someone's face glitch or anything.
See ya around, {PlayerName}!
Really? Wow. That almost makes all the stress, sweat, and panic worth it!
Oh, believe me, I WILL be talking to Merlin about this.
They are, aren't they? And they don't seem to be hurting anybody.
I think we can leave 'em there. Everything else is fixed.
Nah, they don't seem to be causing trouble, and the book is fine.
Oh, NO. My broken code is spreading to other Houses?!
What if it breaks the whole Valley?!
Slow down. How did this happen?
Why were there cherries everywhere?
What kind of video game were you making?
Guess they don't call you "Wreck-It Ralph" for nothing, right?
All I wanted was a SIMPLE game for Sulley.
But I don't know ANYTHING about making a game. So I got a book on coding outta the <Lore>Dreamlight Library</Lore>.
Was it a NORMAL coding book?
Go on...
I'm getting a picture of where this went sideways.
It SEEMED like a normal book! <ActivityItem>Coding Magically for N0v1ces.</ActivityItem>
I wanted to start with the easiest project. The book called it "Cheery Cherries." You walk around and collect cherries. That's ALL!
But when I started to read it out loud, there was a big burst of light and, all of a sudden, my House was full of zoomin' cherries!
On top of that, little things are big! I definitely broke some key code!
Makes me wish my buddy Felix was here.
He could set everything right with one swing of his magic hammer!
What about a Pickaxe with some kind of enchantment?
I'll be a regular Fix-It Felix!
It's not a hammer, but it'll do.
It probably won't make things worse?
Would you? Could you?
If you magic up your Pickaxe and go to the <Lore>House in the Memory</Lore>, that'd be a good start.
I'll check the Valley for more code errors AND re-read the book for a solution!
You think?

I've got everything under control for the moment.
I fixed what I could.
WE'RE ALL DISSOLVING, RALPH. HELP!
Phew! So, I haven't doomed everything and everyone I love yet.
I was flipping through <ActivityItem>Coding Magically for N0v1ces</ActivityItem>, and I noticed a bunch of pages where the Cheery Cherries are MISSING.
So maybe if you <Lore>put the cherries you collected back into the book</Lore>, everything will stop breaking!
But we gotta hurry. The animals and plants are starting to glitch out, too! It's spreading!
What?! AHHHH!
Hold on. Are you messing with me? 'Cause you look fine.
Couldn't resist a little joke.
I'm legitimately worried things are still glitching out there.
I'm starting to get why Vanellope likes you so much.
Now listen up, funnybones, I might've found something important.
